title: "collecting all compositional results"
output: html_document
date: "2026-01-12"
---

Collate compositional results
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
voomclr_results = readRDS("voomclr_prop_results.rds")
ancombc_results = readRDS("ancombc2_prop_results.rds")
sccomp_results = readRDS("sccomp_prop_results.rds")

voomclr_results$method = "voomclr"
ancombc_results$method = "ancombc2"
sccomp_results$method = "sccomp"

#clean and standardize column names
ancombc_results$adj_p_val = ancombc_results$p_val_adj
ancombc_results$raw_p_val = ancombc_results$p_val
ancombc_results$direction = ifelse(ancombc_results$lfc > 0, "up", "down")


voomclr_results$adj_p_val = voomclr_results$adj.P.Val
voomclr_results$raw_p_val = voomclr_results$P.Value
voomclr_results$direction = ifelse(voomclr_results$logFC > 0, "up", "down")

sccomp_results$adj_p_val = sccomp_results$c_FDR
sccomp_results$raw_p_val = NA #not mentioned in sccomp output
sccomp_results$direction = ifelse(sccomp_results$c_effect > 0, "up", "down")


sccomp_results_selected = sccomp_results %>%
  select(cluster, cell_class, contrast, method, direction, adj_p_val, raw_p_val)

#remove cluster_ prefix 
voomclr_results$cluster = gsub("cluster_", "", voomclr_results$cluster)
ancombc_results$cluster = gsub("cluster_", "", ancombc_results$cluster)
sccomp_results$cluster = gsub("cluster_", "", sccomp_results$cluster)

sccomp_results_selected = sccomp_results %>%
  select(cluster, cell_class, contrast, method, direction, adj_p_val, raw_p_val)


sccomp_results_selected = sccomp_results %>%
  select(cluster, cell_class, contrast, method, direction, adj_p_val, raw_p_val)

voomclr_results_selected = voomclr_results %>%
  select(cluster, cell_class, contrast, method, direction, adj_p_val, raw_p_val)

ancombc_results_selected = ancombc_results %>%
  select(cluster, cell_class, contrast, method, direction, adj_p_val, raw_p_val)



combined_results = rbind(voomclr_results_selected,
                             ancombc_results_selected,
                             sccomp_results_selected)


#save combined results 
saveRDS(combined_results, "../combined_compositional_results_all_methods.rds")
```


```{r}
combined_results = readRDS("../combined_compositional_results_all_methods.rds")
#identify results significant in 2 / 3 methods @ FDR of .1
significant_results_at_least_2 = combined_results %>%
  filter(adj_p_val < 0.1) %>%
  group_by(cluster, cell_class, contrast, direction) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  ungroup()


#get adj p values by method for each cluster, cell_class, contrast, direction in one row
significant_results_wide = significant_results_at_least_2 %>%
  select(-raw_p_val) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = adj_p_val, names_prefix = "adj_p_val_") 

significant_results_wide_amyloid = significant_results_wide %>%
  filter(grepl("amyloid", contrast))

#micro 4, micro 5, and astro are only consistent significant amyloid results.

```
